prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your organization’s size, goals, budget, services needed (digital advertising, physician referral marketing, branding, patient experience, CRO, PR), and regulatory requirements (HIPAA/PHI handling). 

To help you pick the best fit, tell me a bit about your needs (or I can research for you). Helpful details:
- What type of organization are you? (hospital system, outpatient clinic, private practice, med device, biotech, payer)
- Primary goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, referral development, employer/customer retention, product launch)
- Annual marketing budget range
- Services you need (SEO/PPC, social, content, creative/branding, PR, analytics, CRM/HIPAA-compliant systems)
- Any must-have experience (working with hospitals, oncology, pediatrics, Medicare population, etc.)

If you want me to proceed now, I can:
- Compile a vetted shortlist (3–7) of St. Louis agencies with proven healthcare experience and a one-paragraph summary of strengths and sample work, or
- Provide a checklist and interview questions to evaluate agencies yourself, or
- Draft an RFP/email template to send to agencies.

Which would you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
